instruction: Candidate software launch paths: Revit 2025: C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe; Archicad 27: C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad Starter.exe; Abaqus 2025: C:\SIMULIA\EstProducts\2025\win_b64\resources\install\cmdDirFeature\launcher.bat. Revit 2025, Archicad 27, and Abaqus 2025 are available at the paths listed above. Choose an appropriate tool from these three to complete the task. Partitioned two-room suite. Start from a blank BIM project. Model a simple one-storey rectangular suite about 8 m by 5 m, add one interior partition, place two rooms named Office A and Office B, and add one door into each room plus two exterior windows. This task focuses on partitioning a shell into separate rooms. Create real BIM model elements rather than visual-only detail geometry. Use the selected application's Room/Zone/Space tool for named rooms so they export as IFC spaces. Save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using the selected application's built-in IFC export. Use IFC4 if the export dialog asks for a setup, and enable room or space export if that option is available. The exported IFC should contain IfcSpace rooms named Office A, Office B; at least 1 building storeys, at least 5 wall elements, at least 1 slabs, at least 2 doors, at least 2 windows. Other dimensions, exact coordinates, materials, family type names, wall thicknesses, and harmless metadata may vary.
source: Open-choice BIM environment; evaluation checks IFC deliverable semantics rather than the selected tool.
